steps.title: Enquiry
steps.body: Client reaches out via form or WhatsApp with project location and stage.

steps.title: Scoping call
steps.body: We confirm tier, visit frequency, and any travel considerations.

steps.title: Engagement letter
steps.body: A clear written agreement is signed before work begins, covering scope, fees, and reporting schedule.

steps.title: First visit & report
steps.body: Dated photo/video documentation with a written summary, delivered within days.

steps.title: Ongoing cadence
steps.body: Regular visits and reports on the agreed schedule, with milestone certification for Verify/Manage clients.
